description: Source code implementing socket utility functions for QUIC protocol on Linux, including message header management, control message handling, socket options, and packet transmission.

classes.name: QuicMsgHdr
classes.description: Represents a message header for UDP socket communication, managing control messages and peer address.

classes.name: QuicMMsgHdr
classes.description: Manages multiple message headers for batch UDP transmission.

methods.name: QuicMsgHdr::SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP info in control message for IPv4 or IPv6.

methods.name: QuicMsgHdr::GetNextCmsgDataInternal
methods.description: Prepares and retrieves the next control message data buffer.

methods.name: QuicMMsgHdr::InitOneHeader
methods.description: Initializes a message header with buffer and peer address.

methods.name: QuicMMsgHdr::SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP info in control message for a specific message index.

methods.name: QuicMMsgHdr::GetNextCmsgDataInternal
methods.description: Prepares and retrieves control message data for a specific message index.

methods.name: QuicMMsgHdr::num_bytes_sent
methods.description: Calculates total bytes sent based on the number of packets.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::GetUDPSegmentSize
methods.description: Retrieves UDP segment size via socket option.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::EnableReleaseTime
methods.description: Enables SO_TXTIME socket option for release time.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::GetTtlFromMsghdr
methods.description: Extracts TTL value from message header control messages.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::SetIpInfoInCmsgData
methods.description: Populates control message data with IP address info.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::SetIpInfoInCmsg
methods.description: Sets control message for IP address info.

methods.name: QuicLinuxSocketUtils::WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a single packet using sendmsg.
